dedupe_keys.name: link and network wide study of incoherent gn egn models

description: Arpanaei, Farhad and colleagues document this resource in the B5G-OPEN community. The study compares closed-form incoherent Gaussian-noise formulations under heterogeneous spans and partially occupied elastic optical links. Accumulated-dispersion correction and modulation-format terms are tested for their effect on prediction accuracy. Coverage is link and network-wide numerical analysis, not a separately identified fibre measurement archive. This record describes the evaluated formulation set; exact equations and parameterisation are not reconstructed from the short metadata. Other optical QoT tools may use related theory without sharing this implementation. Zenodo provides the descriptive publication with open access; its stated licence is cc-by-4.0. Its publication licence does not establish a code licence or source-code availability. A limitation is that the native metadata do not establish all implementation settings, uncertainty bounds or independent reproducibility. Only descriptive metadata were inspected. Related records and companion papers retain their source-defined roles; they do not imply independent measurements.
